title: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease predicted effector genes (Shrine N et al. 2019)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

New genetic signals for lung function highlight pathways and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease associations across multiple ancestries.
Shrine N, Guyatt AL, Erzurumluoglu AM, et al.
Nat Genet. 2019 Mar;51(3):481-493. doi: 10.1038/s41588-018-0321-7.
PMID: 30804560

The authors performed GWAS for several measures of lung function and predicted putative effector genes for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) at each associated locus. Mouse over the column headers for more details about each evidence type.
